title: Upgrade CsWinRT to 2.3.1 and Windows SDK .NET ref pack to 10.0.26100.87

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The accumulated assessment established no remaining source-level defect in the SDK/ref-pack upgrade. The native SDK ABI source and activation contract are unchanged; current callers replace settings rather than mutating a shared default array. The author also addressed the analyzer-guard and submenu-construction questions in source.

**Validation scope:** Five focused source-contract checks have verified identical inputs. A successful current template build and old-host/new-extension plus new-host/old-extension activation, command and callback compatibility matrix have not been established. Source-contract consistency is not a runtime compatibility guarantee.

No additional code change is requested by this assessment. This is a qualified summary, not an unconditional approval.

actions.label: Post qualified assessment summary (no code changes requested)
